english: What's going on over there, I wonder...
Rin-san?\nWhat are you doing there?
Huh!? I-I'm... nothing!\n...Oh, it's you.
What are YOU doing here?
I saw you, Rin-san...\nI just called out to you.
I'm not doing anything,\nso don't worry about it.
Come on, come on, over there, over there!!
What were you looking at...?
Y-you idiot!\nYou don't need to look!
The others...?\nInstead of watching from afar, why don't you talk to them...?\nInstead of hanging around the edges like me...
It's different now.\nI can talk normally.
I was just observing.\nWhat's wrong with that?
Observing... over there...!?
...What? 'Over there' what.
I was thinking maybe you... like girls, Rin-san.\nNo, I'm not judging!
W-wrong!!\nAre you stupid!!
Observing... is there an enemy?\nAmong our comrades, maybe?
Huh? You're serious, huh.\nSure, I did get impersonated once,\nso it's not impossible, but.
That's not what I'm looking for.\nI couldn't tell just by looking anyway.
Enough already.\nLet's go over there.
But then...\nthe reason you were peeping...
Don't call it peeping!\nThat sounds terrible!
I said observing!\nGet that much straight!
...If I did the same thing,\npeople would probably call it peeping.
Obviously?\nThat wouldn't be observing.
I-I see...\nNo, it's not like I want to—\nI just couldn't help noticing the unfairness...
What are you mumbling about, so gloomy.\nBe more cheerful.
Anyway, not a word of this to anyone.\nIf you tell... you'll be sorry.
Y-yes...
You again?
I was thinking the same thing...\nWhat's been up with you lately?
None of your business.\nJust leave me alone.
No matter how curious you look,\nI won't explain.\nYou wouldn't get it anyway.
This is my problem.
...Could it be...?\nYour... chest...
...My... what?\nWanna die? You wanna die...\nOkay, I'll kill you...
Don't worry, it'll be instant.\nBy the time you think 'that hurt,'\nyou'll already be there...
Where...?\n...S-sorry!\nI'm scared...
(She was looking at the busty ones... I knew it...)
...Say that again and I'll crush you\nwith my Kouryuu, no hesitation.
Anyway... so?\nNow that you know, what do you plan to do?
Do... what?
You're the one who wanted to know!?\nPlanning to blackmail me with my weakness?
Too bad for you.\n...I'll crush you with everything I've got.\nThreats won't work on me.
Blackmail...!\nI had no such intention!\nI thought you were troubled, Rin-san.
Me?\nYou were worried about me?
I-if... if it was a misunderstanding, fine!\nYou should've said so\nfrom the start!
It's not the kind of worry I'd confide in you.\nSo don't concern yourself.
I might be able to help...
H-help... as if!\nThere's nothing I could ask you for!
They say talking about it helps...
I can't talk about it.\nIt's personal.
You might be worried about me,\nbut there are things only girls\nunderstand.
Got it?\nI want to be left alone right now.
...Understood.\nWell then, see you.
'See you'... you still plan to worry about it?\nYou're persistent.
Fine, I get it.\nIf it seems like something I can consult you about, I'll talk.\nThat good enough?
But if you laugh then... I'll erase you.
Y-yes... understood...
(Did I stick my nose where it doesn't belong...?)
So, the consultation.\nCan you swear you won't laugh?
Yes. It's fine.
S-so... how do you\nmake them grow?
Asking a guy like you about this\nis definitely weird, but...
Since you're so persistent,\nI swallowed my pride and came to ask.
You've got some good solution, right?
Um... to be clear what we're growing...\ncorrect me if I'm wrong.\n...It's your chest, right?
...I didn't hit you, so it's fine, right?\nI'll hold back properly...
For now, about the growing thing...\nlet's just say that's what it is...
Even if I denied it, you wouldn't believe me.
Understood... thank you.
(What is this... this tightrope of a conversation.\nI feel like I have a knife to my throat...\nWell, she's holding worse than a knife)
So, is there any way\nto make them grow?
Spit out whatever info you have.\nRight now!
Well...\nThere's the theory about early to bed, early to rise\nand drinking milk, but...
I already do that.\nBesides, bad habits are bad for your skin.
I don't think there's a girl who\ndoesn't care about it.
(I don't think it's ALL women who care...)
Hey, is that all\nthe info you've got?
How about exercise, then?\nThey say there's good exercise for bust growth.
...I know that.\nI'm not doing it, but I know it.
...Why are you looking down there!\nI'll kill you!
And besides, we have\ncombat training.\nYou're saying I need MORE than that?
Y-yeah, you're right...
Nothing but useless\nopinions.\nGot anything else?
According to my notes...\nhaving the opposite sex massage them makes them bigger.\nThis... doesn't seem credible.
There's no reason it has to be the opposite sex.
Obviously!\nI'm asking if you have\nRELIABLE info!
Surgery, maybe...?
...That's an extreme option.\nI'm not doing that!\nA guy suggesting that... the worst!
Building chest muscle...
That's just pure muscle!\nWell, it IS the bust, so...\nit'd probably get bigger too...
But getting all buff...\nthat's not quite it.
Geez! This is all useless!\nI thought there'd be an effective method!
Then want to try it?
Huh? Try what?
The method about being massaged by the opposite sex.\nI'll help.
Are you stupid!\nI'll really kill you!
I was an idiot for asking you!
...I didn't mean... anything by it...
Don't come any closer.\nYou're dangerous.
I'm sorry.\nLike I said, I wasn't thinking anything ulterior...
Hmm...\nSo you tried to touch a girl's chest\nWITHOUT thinking about it!?
...In a way, that's really hurtful...
I didn't want to hear that!
(...Either way I get yelled at...\nof course...)
...Stop digging at the wound...\nI appreciate you hearing me out, but...
Boys just don't get it, I guess.\nIt's not like you've thought of\nother methods, right?
No, I haven't...\nI've been thinking, though...
...But do reflect on that 'wasn't thinking'\ncomment.
Yes...\nI'll be careful.
...Fine, whatever.\nNo point staying mad...
I know it's a hard worry\nto understand...
I'll give up on that part.
...I'm sorry...
Forget about this worry.\nI want to forget it.
Okay? Don't bring it up.
Understood... but...\njust one thing?
What? If you say something weird,\nyou won't get off easy.
No.\nI think you're fine just as you are, Rin-san.
H-huh...?\nWhat do you mean?
No... just saying what I think—\nI find you attractive as you are.\n...That's all.
Wh-what... hey!\nI said if you say something weird,\nyou won't get off easy...!
...So I'm supposed to accept that?
.........\nW-well... it doesn't feel bad hearing it.
That's good...\nI was worried I'd get a dirty look...
I-it's not like I'm super happy\nor anything!\nJust a little... okay?
And it's not because it's you!\nAnyone saying it would feel the same!\nIt just doesn't feel bad hearing it!
That's all I get for saying all that...?
...I can hear you.\nGeez... you never finish the job...
...Anyway!\nWe're never touching this topic again!
...Got it?
Yes... understood.
(...If this gets Rin-san back to normal...)
IS units are amazing...\nMakes me envious.
What brought this on?\nCreepy.
Envy all you want, you can't pilot an IS.\nThere's no precedent for men.
I don't know about other worlds, though.
True...\nMaybe there's another world with\nIS units made for men.
I don't even want to think about it...
Why not?
If such a world existed and\nwe could travel between them...\nwar would break out.
IS units have settled into something like\na sport now, but shift a little\nand they're weapons.
If other worlds had them too and they became a threat...\nwe'd have no choice but to fight.
I see...\nYou think about that stuff, Rin-san?
Not really?\nYou raised a weird hypothetical,\nso I gave my opinion.
I don't usually think about\nunrealistic stuff.
Even though I'm living in unreality right now.
You're a hard worker, Rin-san...\nso you'd think of that right away...
Stop it, 'hard worker'...\nI'm just desperate.
But I heard.\nBecoming a personal-unit holder is hard.\nAnd you earned it on your own...
That's the past!\nNow is now!
I have to keep working hard!\nBecause they recognized me and\nentrusted me with a personal unit.
Right?\nI can't let them down.
You're... amazing.\nThat you never get complacent...
Somehow... being around you\nthrows off my rhythm...
S-sorry...
Don't apologize.\nI don't... mind it.
Am I weird...?
Yeah.\nSuper weird!
You know that?\nIt's like a sickness, probably.
I'm not very positive...
I know.\nIf you suddenly turned positive\nit'd be creepy.
Well, it's fine, I guess.\nDon't worry about it.
Huh?
There's demand... right?\nThere's gotta be demand for\nguys like you too.
So it's fine, right?
(That was encouragement... right.\n...I'd get yelled at for thanking her,\nso I won't...)
...Fwaaah...
What's wrong?\nYou look sleepy.
Y-yeah.\nI stayed up a little late.
Training?\nDon't overdo it...
Not that.\nI got hooked on a Japanese game\nand got a little absorbed.
I found an old Japanese game.\nI wasn't expecting much, but.
I tried it\nto clear my head,\nand it's actually pretty good.
Do you play games?
Hmm...?\nI might not play much.\nI don't remember...
I see.\nYou don't look like you'd be good at them.
I've got confidence\nin my reflexes, though...
And it's not just that—\nthe kind that demands judgment\nseems to suit me.
And Japanese games\nhave cute characters.
My country has cute ones too,\nof course,\nbut Japan has a lot of them.
Though I don't play that much\neither.
What kind of games do you play?
Action games.\nObviously.
They're exhilarating, right?\nFighting games are fine too.
That's so you, Rin-san...
...What's that supposed to mean.\nLike you've got me all figured out.\nMakes me sound simple.
I don't care about genre, okay?\nThere's no genre I'm bad at!
How about RPGs?
Japanese RPGs aren't bad either.\nAny genre's fine with me.\nAs long as it clears my head.
Wanna face me, then?\nI'll show you what I've got.
Y-you're that... confident?\nAre you a huge gamer or...?
Of course not.\nI said I just tried it\nto clear my head.
But I am confident.\nI'm good at everything I do.\nHmph.
(She's so confident...\nBut it's not a bluff...)
If you win,\nI'll give you a reward.
Not that you could possibly win.
W-well, of course...\nI'm not much of a gamer...
Then I'll let you pick the game.\nBring one you think\nyou'd be good at.
And I'll crush you utterly.
...Come on.\nWell, if I get to pick...\nmaybe...
Hmm... planning to win, are you...\nFunny.\nHave it ready by next time.
...A game I could win at...
...What's this?
Um... I picked a game.
...This is a game,\nsure, but...
It's a board game!?
I thought you'd pick a video game...\nwere you even listening to me?
It IS... a game?
W-well, yeah.\n...And what is this anyway?\nI've never seen it.
We can't compete with this.\nI can't show my skills either.
Oh, are you bad at board games?\nI thought you weren't bad at anything...\n...Then let's not.
Hah!?\nLike I'd be bad at them!
Fine!\nBoard game or not,\nI'll crush you utterly!
R-really...?\nThis is fine?
It's fine.\nI'll show you my adaptability!
Now, let's start.\nInside it's...\n...like sugoroku...
It's heavily luck-based...
...Something wrong?
N-nothing!\nLuck's part of skill, right? Yeah.\nGo on, you start.
Y-yes...\nIf you insist.
A-and... I'm done...
Impossible...\nMe, losing...
My dynamic vision, my reflexes...\ncompletely useless...
And even so... this margin...\nImpossible.
I just got lucky.\nI racked up points smoothly.
...H-hey, you're not bad!\nSo your luck stat is high—\nth-that I'll... acknowledge.
But... I won't lose next time!\nDon't get cocky just because you\nwon by fluke!
I'm... not getting cocky...
Winning felt purely good, though.\nI didn't think I could win.
...What. Getting cocky?\nI'll get revenge!\nRight now!?
I-I'm not getting cocky at all...!?\n...Urgh.
Playing games with you was fun, Rin-san.
...You can say that\nwith a straight face...?
...I'm a little impressed.
Well, whatever.\nYou beat me, so\nI'll prepare your reward.
No, that's fine...
It's fine, I said so.\nAnd I already thought of the reward—
I'm sure... you'll like it.
I really want you to have it.\n...Specially.
What's with that last part...
It sounds like... a confession's coming...\nNo... surely not.\nBut... if it were...
...Where is this?
Geez, hurry up and come here!
I hear Rin-san's voice...?\nIs it this classroom...?
You finally came!\nYou're slow.
...Rin-san? What's with that outfit?\nAnd where even is this...?
Didn't you see the sign outside?\nIt's a café, a café. It said Café 'SHC,' right?
You overlook things because you're always spacing out.
This outfit's cosplay.\nAt SHC we dress like this.
I see...\nSeeing you dressed like that is fresh.
That's it...?\nDon't you have more to say?
...More to say?\n...Um, is there no menu or anything?
...Sigh.\nI was an idiot to expect anything from you.\nHere. The menu.
Order whatever you like.
...It says 'sweet and sour pork' in huge letters...
You can order whatever you like?
...Then, sweet and sour pork, please.
Yeah yeah! Wait a sec—!
Here, sorry to keep you waiting.\nIt's my pride and joy.
Wow, looks delicious. Thank you for the meal.\n...Mmh. It's really good!
Right? I really wanted you to try it.\nI said it was a reward, right?
I can't cook for you like this any other time...
Th-thank you.\nBut you're amazing, Rin-san...
Making sweet and sour pork doesn't make me amazing.
Not just that—\nlooking good in anything you wear,\nall of that—I think it's amazing.
Wh—!? You're complimenting THAT now!?\nYou said nothing before...
That kind of surprise attack...\nisn't that unfair...
Huh? What is it?
N-nothing!
I-if you want... um...\nI could keep... cooking for you.
...It's not like— I just sometimes want\nto make sweet and sour pork, and... um...
Rin-san... that means... in other words.\nI'm really happy. Rin-san.
What are you doing sleeping here!
...Huh? Rin-san?\nThat outfit... is the cosplay over?
Cosplay? What are you talking about?\nWere you dreaming?
Dreaming about dressing me up in cosplay—\ncarefree, aren't you.
Anyway, this.\nTake it.
Huh? What is this?
Can't you tell by looking?\nIt's a game, a game.\nI said I'd give you a reward, right?
Next time you'll fight me\non my turf.
I can't let losing stand.\nNext time I'll crush you utterly.
...Um, time to practice...?
Learn by doing!\nNow, let's go!
...I don't feel like I can win.\nAt games... or at conversation...
First, I'll treat you to\na perfect game!!
